/-- [tuwunel_kernel::transition]:
    Source: 'ports/tuwunel/kernel/src/lib.rs', lines 428:0-459:1
    Visibility: public -/
def transition
  (s : Snapshot) (req : Request) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  match req.op with
  | Op.Messages room «from» «to» dir limit filter =>
    api_message.get_message_events_route s req.user room «from» «to» dir
      limit filter
  | Op.Context room event limit filter =>
    api_context.get_context_route s req.user room event limit filter
  | Op.Relations room event rel_type event_type «from» «to» limit recurse
    dir =>
    api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter s req.user room event
      event_type rel_type «from» «to» limit recurse dir
  | Op.Threads room «from» limit participated =>
    api_threads.get_threads_route s req.user room «from» limit participated
  | Op.State room => api_state.get_state_events_route s req.user room
  | Op.StateEvent room kind state_key =>
    api_state.get_state_events_for_key_route s req.user room kind state_key
  | Op.Members room «at» membership not_membership =>
    api_members.get_member_events_route s req.user room «at» membership
      not_membership
  | Op.JoinedMembers room => api_members.joined_members_route s req.user room
  | Op.InitialSync room limit =>
    api_room.room_initial_sync_route s req.user room limit
  | Op.RoomEvent room event =>
    api_room.get_room_event_route s req.user room event
  | Op.ServerCanSee origin room event =>
    let b ← svc_accessor.server_can_see_event s origin room event
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.CanSee b))

    Source: 'ports/tuwunel/kernel/src/api_relations.rs', lines 14:0-76:1

def api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter
  (s : Snapshot) (user : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) (target : Std.U64)
  (filter_event_type : Option Kind) (filter_rel_type : Option RelType)
  («from» : Token) («to» : Token) (limit : Option Std.U64) (recurse : Bool)
  (dir : Dir) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  match «from» with
  | Token.Absent =>
    let to1 ←
      match «to» with
      | Token.Absent => ok none
      | Token.At c => ok (some c)
      | Token.Invalid => ok none
    let max_depth ← if recurse
                      then ok 3#u64
                      else ok 0#u64
    let limit1 ← api_message.bounded limit 30#u64 100#u64
    let r ← svc_timeline.get_shortroomid s room
    match r with
    | core.result.Result.Ok x =>
      let r1 ← svc_timeline.get_pdu_id s target
      match r1 with
      | core.result.Result.Ok x1 =>
        let (target_short, target_count) := x1
        let b ← svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events s user room
        if b
        then
          if x != target_short
          then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NotFound)
          else
            if target_count <= 0#i64
            then let r2 ← api_relations.empty
                 ok (core.result.Result.Ok r2)
            else
              let r2 ← svc_timeline.get_pdu s target
              match r2 with
              | core.result.Result.Ok tp =>
                let p ←
                  alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
                    Pdu) s.pdus tp
                let b1 ← api_message.is_ignored_pdu s p user
                if b1
                then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.SenderIgnored)
                else
                  let events ←
                    api_relations.walk s user x target_count none dir max_depth
                      to1 filter_event_type filter_rel_type limit1
                  let recursion_depth ←
                    if max_depth > 0#u64
                    then
                      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref events
                      api_relations.max_depth_of s1
                    else ok none
                  let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                  let next_batch ←
                    if i = 0#usize
                    then ok none
                    else
                      do
                      let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                      let i2 ← i1 - 1#usize
                      let (_, i3, _) ←
                        alloc.vec.Vec.index
                          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Std.U64 ×
                          Std.I64 × Std.Usize)) events i2
                      ok (some i3)
                  let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                  let prev_batch ←
                    if i1 = 0#usize
                    then ok none
                    else
                      do
                      let (_, i2, _) ←
                        alloc.vec.Vec.index
                          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Std.U64 ×
                          Std.I64 × Std.Usize)) events 0#usize
                      ok (some i2)
                  let chunk ←
                    api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter_loop0 
                      s.pdus events (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64) 0#usize
                  ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Relations chunk next_batch
                    prev_batch recursion_depth))
              | core.result.Result.Err _ =>
                let events ←
                  api_relations.walk s user x target_count none dir max_depth
                    to1 filter_event_type filter_rel_type limit1
                let recursion_depth ←
                  if max_depth > 0#u64
                  then
                    let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref events
                    api_relations.max_depth_of s1
                  else ok none
                let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                let next_batch ←
                  if i = 0#usize
                  then ok none
                  else
                    do
                    let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                    let i2 ← i1 - 1#usize
                    let (_, i3, _) ←
                      alloc.vec.Vec.index
                        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Std.U64 ×
                        Std.I64 × Std.Usize)) events i2
                    ok (some i3)
                let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                let prev_batch ←
                  if i1 = 0#usize
                  then ok none
                  else
                    do
                    let (_, i2, _) ←
                      alloc.vec.Vec.index
                        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Std.U64 ×
                        Std.I64 × Std.Usize)) events 0#usize
                    ok (some i2)
                let chunk ←
                  api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter_loop1 s events
                    (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64) 0#usize
                ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Relations chunk next_batch
                  prev_batch recursion_depth))
        else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)
      | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e)
    | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e)
  | Token.At c =>
    let to1 ←
      match «to» with
      | Token.Absent => ok none
      | Token.At c1 => ok (some c1)
      | Token.Invalid => ok none
    let max_depth ← if recurse
                      then ok 3#u64
                      else ok 0#u64
    let limit1 ← api_message.bounded limit 30#u64 100#u64
    let r ← svc_timeline.get_shortroomid s room
    match r with
    | core.result.Result.Ok x =>
      let r1 ← svc_timeline.get_pdu_id s target
      match r1 with
      | core.result.Result.Ok x1 =>
        let (target_short, target_count) := x1
        let b ← svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events s user room
        if b
        then
          if x != target_short
          then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NotFound)
          else
            if target_count <= 0#i64
            then let r2 ← api_relations.empty
                 ok (core.result.Result.Ok r2)
            else
              let r2 ← svc_timeline.get_pdu s target
              match r2 with
              | core.result.Result.Ok tp =>
                let p ←
                  alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
                    Pdu) s.pdus tp
                let b1 ← api_message.is_ignored_pdu s p user
                if b1
                then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.SenderIgnored)
                else
                  let events ←
                    api_relations.walk s user x target_count (some c) dir
                      max_depth to1 filter_event_type filter_rel_type limit1
                  let recursion_depth ←
                    if max_depth > 0#u64
                    then
                      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref events
                      api_relations.max_depth_of s1
                    else ok none
                  let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                  let next_batch ←
                    if i = 0#usize
                    then ok none
                    else
                      do
                      let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                      let i2 ← i1 - 1#usize
                      let (_, i3, _) ←
                        alloc.vec.Vec.index
                          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Std.U64 ×
                          Std.I64 × Std.Usize)) events i2
                      ok (some i3)
                  let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                  let i2 ←
                    if i1 = 0#usize
                    then ok c
                    else
                      do
                      let (_, i3, _) ←
                        alloc.vec.Vec.index
                          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Std.U64 ×
                          Std.I64 × Std.Usize)) events 0#usize
                      ok i3
                  let chunk ←
                    api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter_loop2 
                      s.pdus events (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64) 0#usize
                  ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Relations chunk next_batch
                    (some i2) recursion_depth))
              | core.result.Result.Err _ =>
                let events ←
                  api_relations.walk s user x target_count (some c) dir
                    max_depth to1 filter_event_type filter_rel_type limit1
                let recursion_depth ←

                      alloc.vec.Vec.index
                        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Std.U64 ×
                        Std.I64 × Std.Usize)) events i2
                    ok (some i3)
                let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len events
                let i2 ←
                  if i1 = 0#usize
                  then ok c
                  else

                    let (_, i3, _) ←
                      alloc.vec.Vec.index
                        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Std.U64 ×

                    ok i3

                ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Relations chunk next_batch

Then the bound became (n + 1)^4 < Usize.max: with recursion each yielded event adds a continuation and a child stream, and Usize.max - 1 self-relations still overflow the queue (gpt-6.1-sol, 2026-10-10).
